canonical_location: docs/proof-run.json in the agenthand repo, served at https://ausernameforyou.github.io/agenthand/proof-run.json
fixture_disclosure: A real live end-to-end run, verified and then frozen as the published sample. The run is not staged or reconstructed; presenting it as anything other than the recorded 2026-10-26 run would be false. The demo film's figures come from the filmed run's own receipt, never from this manifest.
purpose: The one source for the published sample run's figures. The site hero and receipt block read this file at load; the README, the site's static fallback text, the replay data and the replay-package records carry the same numbers and are pinned to this file by the test suite (tests/test_docs_proof.py). To publish a different run, replace this file together with that run's frozen files and receipt, and the suite names every surface that must move with it.
